  - The .draft-notice CSS rule is deleted from the four legal pages; the support pages never had it.
  - The EN privacy, EN terms and EN support regions are rendered from the markdown.
  - The AR privacy and AR terms pages keep their old hand-written body inside the markers.

stated_limits: Renderer is strict: render_regions raises when any of the six sources is missing. Until agent 2 writes the three AR sources, T5 and the T4 landing PIN are red, and `python scripts/render_legal_landing.py` must be given the EN pages explicitly.

The fill-in can re-select a FORK after a fill-in, because it recognises the raw or the filled variant (verified). It cannot re-select a DERIVED CLAUSE (DELETION_SECTION, MINORS_CLAUSE, YOUTUBE_CLAUSE, INAPP_NOTIF_CLAUSE, TRADE_NAME_CLAUSE, HOSTING_REGIONS_CLAUSE, TRANSFER_BASIS) once the token is replaced. Changing those answers later needs the pre-fill markdown restored from git first.
D-OLD is truthful to migration 025 but reads badly, by design (spec 4.2 s9).

UF7 limits for the PR text:
- OpenAI spans carry the model name and integer token counts only; the policy states this in one sentence.
- The redis:// fallback client would put cache keys into breadcrumbs (production uses the REST client).
- Paths of unmatched routes are kept verbatim.
The last two are not stated in the policy.
Railway logs: the policy says they 'can record' the requester's IP and the requested web address (C23/T23). Railway's retention, and whether it records client IPs, are NOT VERIFIED.
'Short-lived security checks and copies in temporary storage: expire within 6 hours' is derived from the TTLs in T28/T29 (the longest is home:savings at 6 h).
The support page chrome (meta refresh, CTA, note) still hard-codes support@qaren.app; SUPPORT_EMAIL appears only in the new region. A different support address needs a hand edit of the chrome.
?lang=ar with a missing AR file returns the route's existing 'Content not available.' body; there is no EN fallback.
The renderer supports only the subset the documents use: one-line list items, no nested or numbered lists, no tables, links only for http(s) and mailto.
Placeholder values may not contain < > [ ] backtick * or line breaks. Keys ending in _COUNSEL may span lines and use *. A provided token the documents use may not be empty.
questions_for_orchestrator: Q1. T5 and the T4 landing PIN are red at this hand-off; neither is in UG22's list. The cause: the renderer refuses to render without the AR sources, and the AR pages keep their old body until agent 2 renders them. Every alternative breaks some PIN. An EN fallback in render_regions would keep T5 and T4 green, but the AR pages would then lose their Arabic date anchor, which reddens the T6 parser PIN, and it would silently publish English if an AR file ever went missing. Accept the strict renderer (recommended), or rule a fallback?

Q2. name_ar in processors.json: Latin brand names for 16 rows and 'مواقع المتاجر' for the retailer row. The AR policy must contain each verbatim (T7a). May agent 2 edit name_ar in processors.json if its translation uses Arabic spellings (for example for Apple or Google)? Agent 2 is not listed as owning that file.

Q3. Agent 2 has to add keys to tests/fixtures/legal_fill_in_u8.json: _AR twins for the language-specific values its documents use (WITHDRAW_PATH_AR, SECURITY_LOG_RETENTION_AR, ANON_LOG_RETENTION_AR, GOVERNING_LAW_AR, IP_OWNER_AR, LEGAL_BASIS_COUNSEL_AR, TRANSFER_BASIS_COUNSEL_AR as used). HOSTING_REGIONS_AR is already there. It also has to add 'ar' tables to every fork and clause in scripts/legal_variants_u8.json; the fill-in refuses a document whose fork or clause has no texts for its language. Confirm agent 2 may edit both files.

Q4. ADDRESS_COUNTS will move twice:
- now: EN privacy and terms 7 -> 5; AR privacy and terms 7 -> 5 once rendered from AR markdown that uses the email placeholders;
- again in the fill-in commit: if PRIVACY_EMAIL and SUPPORT_EMAIL are @qaren.app, privacy +4, terms +1, support +1 (each also on the AR twins).
The client agent can set only the first; the fill-in commit must update them again.
